_comment: Tier-2: TOTAL_FORCES lives in core KratosMultiphysics, not in the DEM module — unlike CONTACT_FORCES and ELASTIC_FORCES which are DEM-module attributes. Pitfall (kratos.dem_structures_coupling #4). Executed on Kratos 10.4.3 (pip wheels, glibc-2.31 host, fresh venv). DEMApplication.TOTAL_FORCES_Z raises AttributeError while KM.TOTAL_FORCES_Z resolves; the reverse holds for CONTACT_FORCES / ELASTIC_FORCES / DEM_NODAL_AREA. The fixture imports KratosMultiphysics for real; with Kratos absent the import raises, the process exits non-zero and the runner records a failure, never a pass.
